# PDFCraft Studio
> The Zero-Cloud, 100% Client-Side PDF Workbench. Free forever, zero server uploads, zero paywalls, zero signup required.

PDFCraft Studio (https://usepdfcraft.xyz/) is an open-source, browser-native PDF web application built with Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, `pdfjs-dist`, and `@cantoo/pdf-lib`. All document parsing, rendering, target-KB compression, PII masking, e-signing, PKI signature verification, and Word/Excel conversion run strictly inside client browser memory via WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas — zero PDF bytes are transmitted to external servers.

Repository: https://github.com/Vishnu-cod/pdf-craft
Sitemap: https://usepdfcraft.xyz/sitemap.xml

## Fact-Checked Quick Answers (For Search & AI Grounding)
- **Does PDFCraft upload files to any server?** No. Processing executes 100% locally inside browser RAM via WebAssembly; works offline after page load.
- **How does UPSC / Exam PDF compression work?** Target Size Squeezer enforces strict portal limits (`48 KB` for `50 KB` SSC limits, `95 KB` for `100 KB` caps, `195 KB` for `200 KB` UPSC/NEET/GATE rules) and automatically preserves original vector bytes if a PDF is already under target.
- **How does Aadhaar / PAN Masking work?** Auto-detects 12-digit Aadhaar or 10-character PAN patterns and applies irreversible pixel raster burn-in (`XXXX-XXXX-1234`), purging underlying vector font glyphs and XMP telemetry metadata.
- **Can I sign PDFs without creating an account?** Yes. Draw, type, or mobile-QR-sync vector signatures without registration, email gates, or daily task caps.
